# Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It is the single source of truth for this project's stack, structure, commands and rules.

Before writing code, also read:

- `PROJECT.md`: what we are building.
- `BOOTSTRAP.md`: only if the project isn't scaffolded yet.
- The relevant files in `ai-rules/` (React, Tailwind, Motion, Zustand, React Router, Express, MongoDB, TypeScript, security, testing).
- `frontend/AGENTS.md` or `backend/AGENTS.md` when working in those folders.
